title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-029
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA personnel statements and flight logs regarding the Japan Airlines Flight 628 UFO sighting, which the agency investigated and attributed to weather phenomena.

encounters.summary: Captain Terauchi of Japan Airlines Flight 628 reported observing irregular pulsating lights and a large black object near his aircraft over Alaska.
encounters.communication_content: Pilot signaled the object with wing lights and believed the object was responding to his signals.
encounters.entity_appearance: irregular pulsating lights and a black chunk
encounters.location_name: Arctic Village and Fort Yukon, Alaska
encounters.quote: it seems to be a spaceship
